title: ALPHA03 — Fuller AlphaNIST implementation and visual-orientation extension — deferred
description:
User requested adding this work to the OST on 14 October, explicitly without prioritising it. PARKED: no training, simulator port, paid compute, or implementation started by this ticket. DATA07-R #11050 remains the next experiment.

Opportunity: learn robust manipulation from diverse simulator experience, beyond the easy finishing states in our AlphaNIST-inspired pilot.

Existing evidence:
- ALPHA01 #11041 implements small point-cloud PPO, joint/gripper control, a 64-state controller-derived reset bank and adaptive-versus-uniform reset sampling.
- ALPHA02 #11043 found 0/4 full-start successes and zero new grasps for all tested conditions at 15 seconds. OPEN-only matched all four selected near-goal completions. This does not reject the paper; it limits our pilot.

Deferred implementation requirements:
1. Port and qualify Panda/DUPLO contact physics in GPU-parallel Isaac Lab; benchmark throughput on the 4090 before considering rented GPUs.
2. Build a broader physically valid reset bank spanning unheld pickup, transport, adverse/recovery and near-completion states. Preserve provenance and train/evaluation separation; distinguish naturally difficult states from near-goal finishing opportunities.
3. Match the paper's point-cloud actor/critic, relative joint-plus-gripper control, PPO and success-guided reset allocation. Document any remaining departures from the published multi-task architecture and settings.
4. Train with an explicitly chosen full-task horizon and compatible temporal objective. Longer evaluation alone does not train earlier manipulation phases.
5. Compare adaptive and uniform reset sampling with matched budgets, multiple learning seeds and a frozen panel. Report new grasps, full fresh-start task completion and near-goal completion separately.
6. For our blue-number-2 orientation goal, qualify RGB, coloured point clouds or a visual orientation estimator. Geometry-only input does not establish numeral recognition; this is an extension to the paper's observation contract.
7. Keep original AlphaNIST reproduction, the DUPLO adaptation and the visual extension separately named. Phone recordings can define documented scenes/goals/evaluation; do not call simulator-generated actions recovered human actions.

Scale context, not a purchase plan: the paper reports 64K environments for a main result and 4K per GPU in multi-GPU runs (about 16 GPUs at that configuration). Required scale and training ETA for our simpler task remain unmeasured. The paper says official code release is planned following review/revision; verify availability when work resumes.

Reactivation gate: deliberately reprioritise this item, qualify the environment/reset/observation contracts, then demonstrate new pickup learning before expanding compute. Preserve all prior models/results.
